Login Home About Our people Investment team Adrian Brass Fund manager US equities 4 years at Artemis 31 years' industry experience Biography Adrian joined Artemis in 2022. He manages Artemis' US Extended Alpha long/short strategy alongside co-manager James Dudgeon. He was the lead manager of Majedie Asset Management's US Equity Fund and co-manager of its Global Equity Fund and Global Focus Fund from 2014. Prior to Majedie, Adrian was a fund manager at Fidelity, managing US equity funds including its America Fund, for six years. He holds a Bachelor of Science degree in economics and politics from the University of Bristol and is a CFA charterholder.
